hosts/claude-migration.md

Migrating an older Claude Code installation

These notes describe the historical 1.x → 2.x → 3.x transitions. They do not install Codex support. For a current installation, use the Claude Code guide; to add Codex, use the Codex guide. Paths in old-version columns refer to those historical releases.

Upgrading from 2.x

3.0 moves the Laravel, Next.js and docker/ddev components out of the core into add-ons.

Plugin mode. Install the preset, /plugin install sdd-kit-laravel-nextjs@sdd-kit, to keep what 2.x gave you. Namespaces follow the plugin that ships the component: /sdd-kit-laravel:laravel-12, agents sdd-kit-laravel:laravel-backend-dev and sdd-kit-nextjs:nextjs-frontend-dev. Claude Code installs the preset's dependencies; on claude.ai install each add-on yourself. A SessionStart hint suggests the matching add-on once per project.

File-copy mode. Re-run install.sh (use --dry-run first). With no --stack it installs the Laravel and Next.js add-ons, plus devenv on a fresh install. Moved files are replaced at their new paths, old paths are retired, and every overwritten or removed file is backed up to .claude/.framework-backups/<timestamp>/. A user agent with the same name as an add-on agent wins: the staged copy is dropped and the installer prints the fix. Use --prune to drop add-ons you no longer want. Bare names keep working (/laravel-12, /migrate-db, agent laravel-backend-dev).

Upgrading from 1.x

Re-run the current Claude file-copy installer (or update the Claude plugin). In file-copy mode it removes the files 1.x installed that 2.0 no longer ships (retired agents, skills, templates, and scripts) and backs them up first. It only removes a file whose content matches a copy the kit shipped; a file you edited or replaced (for example an upstream Stripe or skill-creator skill installed at the same path) is listed as "kept (modified or not from the kit)" and left for you to review.

The tables below match the CHANGELOG's Migrating from 1.x section. They list what a 1.x release shipped; components that were added and removed again during the 2.0 cycle appear only in the CHANGELOG's Removed table. Current lists: skills, agents.

Commands

Commands became skills with flat names. Only the commands in the table's left column existed in 1.x; a name that is not listed (for example /kanban or /add-context) never existed as a flat command and has no stub.

1.x 2.0
/upstream:create-spec /write-spec
/upstream:research-spec /write-spec --background (runs the create-spec workflow)
/upstream:tech-research /sdd (or /tech-research directly)
/execution:ship-feature /sdd (or /ship-feature directly)
/execution:fix-bug /sdd (or /fix-bug directly)
/execution:greenfield-build /sdd (or /greenfield-build directly)
/quality:qa-and-docs /sdd (or /qa-and-docs directly)
/quality:code-review /deep-review --depth=standard
/quality:deep-review /deep-review
/quality:test /run-tests
/workflow:status /progress --health
/workflow:doctor /framework-doctor
/workflow:update-knowledge-graph Removed (knowledge graph retired)
/execution:execute-task, /execution:simple-task, /execution:generate, /execution:migrate-db /execute-task, /simple-task, /generate, /migrate-db
/discovery:investigate /investigate
/discovery:analyze-docs /write-docs --audit
/design:design-api, /design:design-schema /design-api, /design-schema
/design:design-ui /design-ui (design add-on)
/quality:grade, /quality:lint, /quality:security-scan, /quality:upgrade-deps /grade, /lint, /security-scan, /upgrade-deps
/release:changelog /changelog
/release:deploy, /release:rollback, /release:feature-flag /deploy, /rollback, /feature-flag (ops add-on)
/operations:health-check, /operations:incident /health-check, /incident (ops add-on)
/workflow:progress, /workflow:sync-obsidian, /workflow:write-docs /progress, /sync-obsidian, /write-docs
/workflow:add-context /write-docs --import
/workflow:getting-started /framework-doctor, then GETTING-STARTED.md
/workflow:kanban /spec-board

/sdd routes work to the right workflow. The workflows stay directly runnable as /ship-feature, /fix-bug, /qa-and-docs, /tech-research, /greenfield-build, and /create-spec.

The old namespaced commands remain as redirect stubs in .claude/commands/ (full installs and plugin mode; they are still shipped in 3.x and go in a later release). They are manual-only: Claude will not pick them on its own. A stub translates old flags that changed meaning (/workflow:add-context, /workflow:kanban, /workflow:status) and, for a user-invoked skill such as /changelog or /framework-doctor, tells you the command to type. /workflow:update-knowledge-graph has no replacement; its stub only explains the retirement.

Removed skills and templates

Skills and templates are removed as well, not only commands:

1.x 2.0
obsidian-sync /sync-obsidian
stripe-best-practices, upgrade-stripe, stripe-projects Stripe's published skills: install.sh --project --third-party installs stripe-best-practices and upgrade-stripe (pinned in share/settings/third-party.json); stripe-projects is installed by hand (docs/third-party.md)
skill-creator Anthropic's skill-creator plugin (third-party manifest)
prompt-engineering-patterns Removed (outside the kit's scope)
src/templates/code/* laravel-12/assets/templates/, nextjs-15/assets/templates/, used by /generate
src/templates/specs/{feature,epic,user-story,requirements,code-review-checklist}.template.md, execute-task-workflow.md write-spec templates, product-brief assets, specification-system.md
src/templates/specs/feature-flag-doc.template.md feature-flag/references/flag-doc.template.md (ops add-on)
src/templates/context/workflow.template.md None: the Golden Triangle is business rules, architecture, and API contracts (templates/context/golden-triangle.md); the process lives in /sdd and AGENTS.md
src/templates/commands/_templates/command.template.md src/templates/skills/_templates/ (commands became skills)
src/templates/knowledge-graph/* Removed (knowledge graph retired)
drupal-11 (core in 1.x) drupal-11 in the drupal add-on (--stack=drupal)

Merged, moved, and removed agents

1.x 2.0
api-dev laravel-backend-dev
integration-dev laravel-backend-dev
database-dev database-designer
monitor, log-analyst, support-analyst ops-analyst (ops add-on)
code-reviewer Removed; /deep-review uses adversarial-reviewer
deployment-specialist, rollback-specialist, incident-responder Same names, ops add-on

intake-processor requirements-analyst, /product-brief --intake

git-workflow /open-pr

If you used the moved agents, add the add-on: --stack=laravel,nextjs,ios --with=ops,design or the matching sdd-kit-* plugins.

Knowledge graph retired

Memory is now Claude Code auto memory plus agent memory (memory: project in agent frontmatter). The installer already removes the knowledge-graph-manager and learning-extractor agents, scripts/kg-capture.sh, scripts/init-knowledge-graph.js, and hooks/post-change-kg-sync.sh, and drops the kg-capture hook from settings.json. It does not touch your data or MCP config, so finish the cleanup by hand:

  1. Remove the knowledge-graph entry from mcpServers in .mcp.json (or claude mcp remove knowledge-graph).
  2. Delete .claude/knowledge-graph.jsonl and .ai/knowledge-graph.jsonl if present. Move anything worth keeping into CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or .claude/rules/ first.

Other leftovers

  • 1.x left *.backup.* copies inside .claude/. The installer warns about them; delete them once you no longer need them.
  • Cards in a 1.x .ai/kanban.json are not read by /spec-board, which takes status from the spec files. A card with a spec needs nothing. Drop the DONE, IN_PROGRESS, and REVIEW cards that have no spec: that work is already started or finished, and a backlog slice would re-plan it. Migrate only the BACKLOG and TODO cards without a spec: paste their titles and descriptions into /product-brief --intake "<cards>" (with no product-brief.md yet, it offers to write the brief first or to start a backlog only), or turn one into a spec with /write-spec. Then delete the file.
  • Documents imported with 1.x /workflow:add-context into .claude/context/business/, .claude/context/architecture/, or .claude/context/workflow/ are no longer read by anything: their only readers were the retired context-fetcher agent and the knowledge graph. Re-import each one into the Golden Triangle paths that /write-spec, create-spec, and /framework-doctor read: /write-docs --import .claude/context/<dir>/<file> --as=business (or --as=architecture, --as=api; for workflow/ files, pick the one that fits or fold them into AGENTS.md). Then delete .claude/context/. /framework-doctor warns while it exists.
  • docs/context/workflow.md from 1.x /workflow:getting-started is no longer generated, and CLAUDE.md no longer loads it. The SessionStart (compact) hook still re-injects its first lines after a compaction while the file exists, so fold anything still true into AGENTS.md (commands, red lines) and delete it.
  • Files the installer kept because they no longer match the kit's copy are listed as "kept" in its plan; review each and delete the ones you do not use (a kept 1.x agent in a category folder, such as agents/quality/code-reviewer.md, still loads next to the flat 2.0 agents).
  • A 2.0 --minimal install ships no .claude/commands/, so a 1.x full install's namespaced commands stay behind. /framework-doctor flags them; delete the namespaced folders (upstream/, quality/, execution/, workflow/, _shared/, and so on) under .claude/commands/.
